title: Compactness and Connectedness in Aura Topological Spaces
summary: This is the second paper in a series on aura topological spaces $(X, τ, \mathfrak{a})$, where $\mathfrak{a}: X \to τ$ is a scope function with $x \in \mathfrak{a}(x)$. We study covering and connectivity properties in this setting. Five compactness-type notions are defined ($\mathfrak{a}$-compact, $\mathfrak{a}$-Lindelof, countably $\mathfrak{a}$-compact, $\mathfrak{a}$-sequentially compact, $\mathfrak{a}$-limit point compact) and their mutual relationships are determined.
